Arrival

Check-In

Check-in is available from 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM. Checkout is 10:00 AM.

1

Before arrival

Your unique door code will be available in your SuiteOp link after you have completed all required steps in the guest portal.

2

Upon arrival

Enter through the main entrance and use your door code.

3

Gate tip

Pull the handle toward you while entering the code so the lock lines up correctly. Entering the code before pulling, or turning the handle too soon, can cause it to jam. A few failed attempts in a row may temporarily lock the code out.

4

Shoes & slippers

We recommend taking shoes off inside. Indoor slippers are available in the walk-in closet.

Trouble checking in? Reach out via the Airbnb message thread.

Pool Maintenance & Rules

Maintenance Schedule

Our pool technician, Carlos, services the pool every Monday and Thursday to keep it clean and ready for guests. He'll only need access to the outdoor/pool area — no action is required on your end. Thank you for your understanding while he's on-site!

Pool Rules & Regulations

  • No lifeguard on duty — swim at your own risk, and always supervise children closely.
  • No diving — the pool is not designed for diving.
  • No glass containers of any kind in the pool or pool deck area.
  • Please shower before entering the pool.
  • No running on the pool deck.
  • Pets are not permitted in the pool.
  • Pool hours are dawn to 10:00 PM — please keep noise low in the evening out of respect for neighbors.
  • No food in the pool; please use the outdoor dining area instead.
  • Please secure the pool gate/area when not in use, especially with children present.
  • Report any pool issues (equipment, cleanliness, temperature) via the Airbnb message thread right away.

Backyard

Fireplace

General guidance for safe use of the outdoor fire feature.

1

Turning it on

Locate the gas valve/knob and turn it to the "on" position, then use the igniter button or switch to light the flame. Give it a moment to catch before adjusting.

2

Adjusting the flame

Use the control knob to raise or lower the flame to a comfortable, controlled size. Avoid leaving it on the highest setting unattended.

3

While in use

Never leave the fire unattended. Keep children and pets at a safe distance, and keep flammable items (blankets, cushions, paper) well away from the flame.

4

Turning it off

Turn the control knob back to "off" and shut the gas valve completely. Allow the glass/surface to cool fully before covering it back up.

If you notice a gas smell, unusual noise, or the flame won't light, please stop use and message us through the Airbnb thread right away.

Before you leave

Check-Out

Checkout is at 10:00 AM.

  • Dispose of any pet waste (fee applies if not done).
  • Clean the grill if used (fee applies if not done).
  • Load and run the dishwasher (no heat-dry).
  • Towels in the washer with 1 Tide pod, cold wash; dry if possible.
  • Bag and dispose of all trash, including refrigerated items.
  • Gather all belongings — items left behind are discarded, not shipped.
  • Set thermostat to 72–74°F.
  • Return moved furniture/décor to original positions.
  • Secure the property — windows and doors closed and locked.
  • Turn off all lights and appliances.
  • Return garage clicker/keys to the designated key holder.
  • Lock the front door via the electronic lock.

City of Irving

Trash Disposal

City of Irving collects trash on Tuesday and Friday mornings. If you have any trash, please bag it and place it at the front curb by the street before morning pickup. Thank you!

From your host

About Your Host

My name is Kris and I run a small, locally operated Airbnb and property-management business here in DFW. Hosting started as a side project outside my 9 to 5, but it grew into something I genuinely enjoy. I love creating spaces where guests feel comfortable, taken care of, and at home the moment they walk in.

I'm a Dallas native & Texas Tech alum, class of 2018, and I built this business to create something meaningful for myself while also being able to support my parents as they get older. Every stay helps me continue growing this small business, and I truly appreciate it.

If you enjoy your stay, a 5-star review goes a long way for a host. Anything under 5 stars can hurt the visibility of the listing. If anything feels off during your stay, please message me through the Airbnb thread and I'll take care of it quickly — I want your experience to be smooth from start to finish.
